criteria_results.text: Activity renders active, waiting, failed, and completed items with source labels and transcript/result deep links when the underlying record supplies one.
criteria_results.notes: The iOS development client launched successfully against the deterministic E2E server, but opening Agents > Activity rendered “Could not load activity — Activity request failed (404)” instead of the seeded activity item. Inspection showed the E2E activity transport requested /mobile-gateway/agent-activity directly while the fake gateway serves the authenticated route under /__mobile/:host/mobile-gateway/agent-activity.

criteria_results.text: Loading, empty, offline-cache, expired-auth, forbidden, and retryable-error states are accessible, dark-mode compatible, and Dynamic Type safe.
criteria_results.notes: The retryable-error state rendered legibly with a clear Try again action. Other resilient states were not checked in this rehearsal.

failure_output: Could not load activity — Activity request failed (404)
suggested_follow_up: Integrate the active lifecycle corrective branch, retain a native development-client Activity smoke against the fake authenticated gateway, and require the seeded activity item to render before the prototype gate passes.
